lines.en: Why you stick on me, baby?
Cold makes you sound so brave.
It's fun. God, I love how sexy I am.
So I need to write some depressing stuff to go with my new bluesy voice.
But nothing that sad has ever really happened to me.
Well, how about your mom dying?
Or having to live on the streets when you were 14?
Oh, yeah, I could write about the time my hair did that woo-hoo thing.
